items.claim: CEO 宣布上修 2026 全年營收與 pro forma EPS 財測
items.quote: We now expect 2026 revenue of approximately $8.05 billion
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明全年毛利率財測上修，且已納入下半年記憶體成本
items.quote: increased our gross margin estimate to approximately 59.7%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給出全年營業利益率約 27%，較前次財測高 150bp
items.quote: approximately 27%, 150 basis points higher
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 將 pro forma 有效稅率財測由 16% 調為 16.5%
items.quote: effective tax rate of 16.5%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給出全年自由現金流財測
items.quote: full year 2026 free cash flow to be approximately $1.4
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說毛利率與營業利益率擴張多數來自產品組合，另含 2,100 萬美元關稅退款
items.quote: Margins also benefited from a $21 million tariff refund
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 給出 Q2 合併毛利率與年增幅
items.quote: margin was 62.4%, a 360 basis point increase
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說明「mix」的定義：較高毛利的新產品在銷售組合中占比提高
items.quote: products in our families that come out at higher margins
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明毛利率財測不含 Q2 已認列以外的額外關稅退款
items.quote: any additional benefit related to tariff refunds
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說 Marine 毛利率擴張主因為關稅退款
items.quote: The primary driver of margin expansion was the tariff refund
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說 Auto OEM 毛利率擴張來自年度累計成本回收於本季認列為營收
items.quote: year-to-date cost recoveries that were recognized as
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 承認記憶體成本是逆風
items.quote: we recognize that's a headwind
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說記憶體策略性庫存使高價成本尚未進財報，預期下半年開始影響
items.quote: expect that to start to impact us in the back half
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說其他零組件在 AI 需求下也都承壓，但變動較小
items.quote: certainly under pressure because of the AI demand
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示將用處理關稅的同一套做法因應記憶體成本
items.quote: same playbook with memory as we did with tariffs
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示利潤率策略不倒退
items.quote: it's never our strategy to go backwards.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 預期 Outdoor 下半年營收表現轉強，全年成長優於 2025
items.quote: stronger revenue performance in the back half of 2026
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示 Marine 全年成長預期與去年一致
items.quote: growth that is consistent with that of the prior year
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 預期 Fitness 為 2026 合併成長最大貢獻者
items.quote: continue to expect the Fitness segment will be the strongest
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說 Auto OEM 下半年營收將下滑並回到營業虧損，直到 2027 年 Mercedes-Benz 新專案
items.quote: we are expecting revenue to decline and the return to an

items.quote: auto OEM would again return to growth
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 CIRQA 上市後反應優於預期
items.quote: very strong, ahead of our expectations
items.speaker: CEO

items.quote: They can certainly add the additional features of Connect+
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 對是否進入其他穿戴形態不評論產品路線圖
items.quote: I won't comment specifically on our product road map.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 AXIS 反應強烈並自述市場上無類似產品
items.quote: There's really nothing else like it out on the market

items.claim: CEO 說收購不考慮傳統綜效，著眼於 360 度使用者體驗
items.quote: we're really not thinking about any of those

qa_flags.response_pattern: 未直接回答持續性或給數字，改談記憶體逆風與 mix 的一般性定義

qa_flags.question: Erik Woodring 詢問是否擴展到其他穿戴形態
